usage:
import os

from openai import Client

client = Client(
    api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

result = client.realtime.client_secrets.create(expires_after={"anchor": "created_at", "seconds": 600}, session={"type": "realtime", "output_modalities": ["audio"], "model": "string", "instructions": "string", "audio": {"input": {"format": {"type": "audio/pcm", "rate": 24000}, "transcription": {"model": "string", "language": "string", "prompt": "string", "delay": "minimal"}, "noise_reduction": {"type": "near_field"}, "turn_detection": {"type": "server_vad", "threshold": 1, "prefix_padding_ms": 1, "silence_duration_ms": 1, "create_response": True, "interrupt_response": True, "idle_timeout_ms": 1}}, "output": {"format": {"type": "audio/pcm", "rate": 24000}, "voice": "string", "speed": 1}}, "include": ["item.input_audio_transcription.logprobs"], "tracing": "auto", "tools": [{"type": "function", "name": "string", "description": "string", "parameters": {"key": None}}], "tool_choice": "none", "parallel_tool_calls": True, "reasoning": {"effort": "minimal"}, "max_output_tokens": 1, "truncation": "auto", "prompt": {"id": "string", "version": "string", "variables": {"key": "string"}}})
print(result)

fields.name: expires_after
fields.description:
Configuration for the client secret expiration. Expiration refers to the time after which
a client secret will no longer be valid for creating sessions. The session itself may
continue after that time once started. A secret can be used to create multiple sessions
until it expires.

fields.name: session
fields.description:
Session configuration to use for the client secret. Choose either a realtime
session or a transcription session.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.description: Expiration timestamp for the client secret, in seconds since epoch.

fields.name: session
fields.description: The session configuration for either a realtime or transcription session.
